parsed.name: 扫描器通信接口
parsed.description: 用于实验系统中的非物理扫描器通信组件，提供向扫描器发送命令以及暴露文件描述符的能力，便于将设备通信接入事件循环、轮询或底层 I/O 监控流程。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical scanner communication component used in laboratory systems. It provides methods to send commands to a scanner and expose a file descriptor, enabling integration with event loops, polling, or low-level I/O monitoring.

actions.description: 获取该扫描器通信接口对应的文件描述符。
actions.description_en: Get the file descriptor associated with this scanner communication interface.

actions.description: 向扫描器发送命令，并可选择等待返回响应。
actions.description_en: Send a command to the scanner and optionally wait for a reply.
